statement: When many NRI trajectory records share the same latent interaction graph, trajectory-record-level differential privacy is not, by definition, a topology-privacy guarantee: changing/removing one trajectory and changing one latent interaction edge are different neighboring relations, and the latter can change the distribution of many records.
notes: This is a formulation claim about the protected unit, not an empirical claim that record-level DP necessarily permits successful topology inference at every privacy budget.
